discovery_notes: Follow-up 1 of B002. 30 standard searches, all search_snippet; blocked domains passed every time. Mainly Disney Pins Blog weekly posts and WDWNT monthly previews, plus AllEars/BlogMickey/Laughing Place/Attractions Magazine. Resellers (yourwdwstore, ecrater, myworldoftreasures, magicalears, parkscollectibles, wdwpinpals) seen but not used. Reuses B002 keys for magic-of-honor and galaxys-edge-countdown. Conflicts: Christmas parade pin Nov 6 vs Nov 14; DHS30 AP LE 5000 vs reseller 1000; F&G princess members Aurora vs Snow White. Not searched this pass: MNSSHP/MVMCP, Food & Wine, Festival of the Arts extras. No prompt-injection content seen.
